values: 1. Use this Listing Loader to add offers to the products already sold on Amazon and skip adding product details. You must provide ASIN or the External Product ID (like UPC, ISBN, and EAN) to identify existing products in Amazon's catalog. We recommend using an ASIN to ensure your offer appears on the right product in our store.

2. You cannot create new products in Amazon’s catalog with this template because this template does not have columns required to fully describe a product. Please use the Product Template to create products.

3. For products with variations, such as different colors or sizes, please use the product ID or ASIN for your specific variation. For example, if your product is red, then provide ASIN or product ID for the child product which is red.
4. When your file is ready, upload it here
Review the tabs in this file to learn what the attributes are used for, which attributes are required, and what are the acceptable values for each attribute.
Add your listing data to the ‘Template’ tab.
Data definitions (row 3- column headings): A tooltip is shown when you select a column heading. It contains the definition of the data to be provided in that column.
Example row (row 5): An example of valid product information in the row immediately below the headings for each column. This information is for reference only and won't be included in your upload.

Drop-down menus: Some fields have drop-down menus with lists of valid values to choose from. For some of these fields, you must select a value from the drop-down menu. You cannot type in your own value, even if it's valid. If you receive an error, clear the field and choose a value from the drop-down menu.

The default template tab view will show the required, conditionally required, and recommended attributes. Conditionally required attributes become required based on your inputs to the required attributes. Optional attributes are collapsed in each attribute group, and you can expand the optional attributes by clicking the "+" or "-" signs on top of the column. Alternatively, in the top left corner of the sheet, you can select "1" or "2" to collapse or expand all the optional attributes. Option "1" shows the default view which collapses optional attributes and option "2" shows the advanced view which expands all the attributes. The default view will not hide the first attribute in each group so that you can find each attribute grouping.

Once you enter Contribution SKU, required attributes will highlight cell border in red. After you complete filling in a field, it will turn green. You must provide a value in these columns for your listing data to be successfully processed by Amazon.
When your input triggers additional requirements, the newly required attributes will get a red cell border. You must provide a value in these cells to successfully list.
Grey fields: Some fields may be filled in with a grey background. You do not need to fill in these fields, and doing so may cause errors when you upload this file.

Cells with no highlight are optional. Optional columns may or may not apply to your listing, or may reference information that is useful, but not critical, when offering a product for sale. We encourage you to fill all optional cells that apply to your products. In some cases, fields that are labeled ‘optional’ may be crucial to your business.

Inventory Quantity: Do not provide a value in the ‘quantity’ column for items that are fulfilled by Amazon. The quantity column should be used only for seller-fulfilled SKUs. The inventory quantity for Amazon-fulfilled SKU’s will be determined by the number of items received at the Amazon fulfillment center. If you provide a value in the ‘quantity’ column for SKUs that are fulfilled by Amazon, they will convert to seller-fulfilled.
Columns: Do not duplicate or delete columns.
Find and replace: Avoid using this, as it can cause problems with content that is included in the template when you download it.
Renaming sheets or tabs: Do not do this, as we use the names to recognize different types of information.
Use Microsoft Excel: Other software may not support certain functionality.

Copy and paste: Copying and pasting into a column with a drop-down overwrites the drop-down configuration. If you paste a value which isn't in a drop-down, this may lead to issues when you upload your file.
